name: hubspot-deal-stage-velocity-benchmark-calculator
description: n8n workflow that extracts HubSpot deal stage history, benchmarks time-in-stage and stage-to-stage conversion durations, and flags stalled deals and pipeline bottlenecks.
author: DH Robin (dhRobin Systems)

scripts.lint: node --check src/config.js && node --check src/velocityEngine.js && node --check scripts/build-workflow.js && node --check scripts/simulate.js && node --check scripts/generate-fixtures.js && node --check test/velocityEngine.test.js && node --check test/workflow.test.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('workflow.json','utf8'))"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build:check && npm test
